subject: The fitted-bedroom journey from measure to installation
hook: Fitting day, from dust sheets to handover
ig:
Fitting day, from dust sheets to handover. This is the typical order we work in.

Protect first. Floors and the route upstairs are covered before a single unit comes through the door.

Position, then level. Units go in from the corner outward, and every one is levelled and fixed so drawers run true.

Scribe. Fillers are trimmed to the actual line of your walls and ceiling, which is where a fitted wardrobe starts to look built in.

Doors and fittings. Doors are hung and the gaps between them aligned, then every soft-close hinge and handle is checked.

Handover. We clean down and walk you through it.

Save this so you know what to expect, and use the link in bio to see finished work.
fb:
What does fitting day actually look like when our team arrives?

In short: we protect your floors, bring the units in already assembled, level and fix each one, then trim fillers to your walls so there are no gaps. Doors go on last and every hinge and handle gets checked before we clean down and walk you through it.

It's the same team from our Hanley workshop, which means the people fitting it know how it was built. Swipe through for each stage, then see some finished work here:
